title: Grouping Plants
summary: Herbs, shrubs and trees; taproots and fibrous roots; net-like and parallel veins, and the hidden monocot–dicot pattern.

ib.note: Formal plant taxonomy follows in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: Diversity in the Living World

objectives: I can group plants as herbs, shrubs or trees.
I can identify taproot and fibrous root systems, and reticulate and parallel venation.
I can find the link between leaf venation and root type (dicots and monocots).
misconceptions: All tall plants are trees with taproots.
Grass is not a flowering plant.
Plants can only be grouped one way.
